verdict.rationale: Webhook ingestion is well documented: Inngest supports any number of unique webhook URLs per third-party service. Event-triggered runs are implied by child runs "triggered by another run (via event, invoke, or defer)" and by users describing it as a trigger solution where you "event everything." However, the pack has no explicit documentation of declarative event triggers on functions, of queue-sourced triggers, or of one event fanning out to many functions. Missing for 10: explicit docs on declarative event-trigger configuration, queue-sourced triggers, one-event-to-many-functions fan-out, and hands-on corroboration of fan-out.
